notes: Portable Annex C.9 note-label collision witness through standard federation MOM HLAcurrentFDD. The adapter supplies the provider package, standard MIM, both schema-valid FOM modules, endpoint, logical time, and callback model. Only distinct referenced labels and preserved note semantics are asserted; no provider-specific label spelling or private composer behavior is required. For §4.15.1, the C++ TCK verifies that XML noteReferences pointers are retained on the composed CurrentFDD table entry in both module orders; tabular OMT bracket/asterisk syntax is not exercised. For §4.15.2, the C++ TCK fixtures also provide a selected valid Table 44 note-template/name witness, but do not validate arbitrary invalid labels or every HLA naming rule. Fresh installed-package MinGW/Ninja CTest passed the C++ primary/contract pair 4/4 across HLA_EVOKED/HLA_IMMEDIATE. Prior focused Java packaged-provider runtime passed in both callback models; interoperability is unverified.
